title: The Cover of Geneva Anew
author: Jonah Okonkwo
blurb: Zephyrine Sandoval, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must trade the one secret worth killing for before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
